basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer based in Seattle, with a passion for open-source technology and digital organization tools. I've been dabbling in programming since my high school days and have a degree in Computer Science. Besides coding, I love hiking in the Pacific Northwest and exploring new cultures through travel. I'm usually online in the evenings and weekends, sharing tech tips and helping the community troubleshoot. I'm currently single and enjoy my independence, spending my free time either on the trail or behind a screen.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in software development, having worked in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise lies in backend development and database management, skills honed through formal education and continuous self-learning via online courses and tech forums. I frequently experiment with new software tools and contribute to open-source projects.
